scope: Citywide annual operational totals, not neighborhood observations or ordinary-day counts
source_title: City of Minneapolis 2024 Traffic & Parking Services Accomplishments, page 23
acquisition_method: Transcribed numerical table from official report text returned by web search; direct PDF download returned HTTP 404
limitations: These are category labels, not an official reason-code dictionary.
No neighborhood or day identifiers; do not join these totals to neighborhood income.
Do not interpret subtraction of snow-emergency reasons as non-snow-day totals.
Do not sum categories without confirming overlap and coverage.
Operational totals may differ from the selected event layers; do not force them to reconcile.
